title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1632: Mixed blood (3)

section.p: Su Yu’s complicated emotions did not last long. He was able to rapidly calm himself down. He could only accept that all villains were good at pretending. There was no need for him to let something like this affect his emotions.
He looked at the distance Great Yuan King. The newly recovered and slightly pale Great Yuan King gnashed his teeth and charged toward Su Yu again with a look of madness.
“You can kill me once, but can you kill me twice? I only need to kill you once and it will be over for you!”
Once again, the battle resumed.
Great Xia King could no longer continue holding back. He rushed toward them and roared, “Su Yu, please hold back for Xia Family’s sake! Old Yuan has lost control. He doesn’t know what he’s doing…”
“Piss off!”
Both Su Yu and Great Yuan King shouted at the same time before attacking Great Xia King like rabid dogs.

The furious Great Xia King took Su Yu’s punch with his back as he swung his saber at Great Yuan King while roaring, “Su Yu! This is a misunderstanding! The human race will give you an explanation for this! Please stop! You already killed one of his body!”
He did not want to see Su Yu killing Great Yuan King.

Yes, his friendship with Great Yuan King was one of the reasons, but upon killing Great Yuan King, Su Yu would no longer be able to become the leader of humanity. This would be the end result even if Great Yuan King was the one who had attacked first.
Humanity might not do anything to Su Yu this time, but many would start holding resentment against him. This wasn’t a good thing. Great Xia King did not want to see that happening.
Great Xia had contributed a lot to the conference. No matter what, Su Yu was born in Great Xia. Great Xia King naturally hoped that he could return to the Human Realm.
As for Su Yu, he frowned when he noticed that there was still madness in Great Yuan King’s eyes. Clearly, losing one tri-life body was not enough to wake Great Yuan King from his madness.
Was the influence of the tri-life bodies on one’s mental state really that big?
How terrifying.
Seeing that Great Xia King, someone absolutely stronger than him was finally interfering, Su Yu sent a voice transmission, “Lord Flat, stop his sea of willpower for a split second.”
“Who?”
“Great Xia King!”
“Alrighty!”
The female furball agreed cheerfully. Perhaps this would be a good chance for her to stealthily eat some of Great Xia King’s willpower while doing her job. Nobody would notice, right?
She was in a good mood.
Meanwhile, Great Xia King was still thinking of stopping Su Yu. With him standing in the way, Su Yu would have no chance of killing Great Yuan King.
Just then, Su Yu threw a punch at Great Yuan King.
Naturally, Great Yuan King was also rushing toward Su Yu.

Just as Great Xia King was about to separate the two once again, his expression changed. His mind had blanked out for a split second. During that split second, Su Yu’s punch struck, blasting Great Yuan King apart yet again.

Only then did Great Xia King erupt in strength and swing his saber. The attack left a slight crack on the Mark of Civilization. It also left a wound on Su Yu’s forehead. Great Xia King had an unsightly expression.
He stared at Su Yu and the Mark of Civilization.
“You…”
He was cursing inwardly.
That little shit! Just what kind of monster had the damn kid brought into the Human Realm?
Most people did not notice anything.
They only saw Great Xia King hesitating for a split second, resulting in Great Yuan King’s loss of a second tri-life body to Su Yu.
Far away, the prefect of Great Yuan wailed in desperation, “Great Xia King, please save my father! He might have wronged, but he doesn’t deserve death! Please show mercy!”

Then, he dropped to his knees. He had thought that the slight delay was deliberate. Great Xia King had delayed at the final moment. Many believed the same. They concluded that Great Xia King had ultimately picked Su Yu’s side.
That was why he had allowed Su Yu to kill Great Yuan King’s second tri-life body. Was Great Xia King giving Su Yu the chance to fully vent his anger?
“So they’re really being serious here.”
When Great Yuan King lost his second body, nobody suspected that this was an act anymore.
Act?
How was this possible?

Great Yuan King had lost both his present and future bodies. Left with only his past body, he would weaken considerably. Even if he could continue cultivating his past body, he would most likel be stuck at the fourth or fifth degree. That was far weaker than his previous strength as a seventh-degree Eternal.
Furthermore, he would be left with only one life after this. Such a loss was almost irreversible.
From one of the strongest human experts, he had dropped to one of the weaker ones among the middle-degree Eternals. Why was he considered weaker? Because he was left with only one life.
There was no way this was merely an act.
Could Great Yuan King’s third body even survive this?
Once again, the River of Time shook.
A short while later, Great Yuan King emerged from the river. This time, he had a look of clarity in his eyes.
This was a past body. A Great Yuan King of the past.

He looked much younger, and the pride in his eyes had faded significantly, replaced with humility. With a look of recollection, he looked at both Su Yu and Great Xia King before smiling bitterly, “I lost. What a surprise. Truly a surprise. I can’t even defeat you…I am truly an embarrassment. Old Xia, move aside. Since I was the one to make the first move, I deserve death upon losing. Su Yu, I admit that I’m not your match. As promised, Great Yuan will support your ascension upon my defeat. Our quarrel does not involve anyone else. Old Xia, Old Zhou, I deserve this.”

With one step, he left his River of Time. With an overbearing and dignified expression, he said, “Kill me, Su Yu. But I won’t stop fighting until the very end. Remember, this is only between the two of us. It has nothing to do with anyone else. Move aside, Old Xia. I am not lowly enough to wag my tail and beg for mercy. I do not require protection.”
Great Xia King studied Great Yuan King with a frown before looking at Su Yu and saying, “He’s finally awake. Su Yu, he’s awake!”

He knew that Su Yu had a Daofuse on him. A soul devourer Daofuse. He had reached a certain conclusion. Today, nobody would be able to stop Su Yu from killing Great Yuan King. Not Great Xia King himself, not Old Zhou, nobody. With the assistance of a Daofuse, nobody present could stop Su Yu.
Of course, it wasn’t like things were completely hopeless. Great Ming King was here as well. There was still a tiny bit of hope for them to prevail over Su Yu and the Daofuse.
But this would only result in a pyrrhic victory regardless of the victor. Furthermore, the Human Realm would instantly turn into a living hell the moment Su Yu opened a death tunnel.

Su Yu had a cold expression as death qi swirled around his body. Yes, he could see that Great Yuan King had finally recovered. But…wouldn’t it be a tad too embarrassing for him to stop after promising so loudly that he would kill Great Yuan King?

Just then, Great Zhou King said, “Mayor Su, this whole thing is a misunderstanding. Great Yuan King had lost control due to his tri-life bodies. Now, he has finally regained his clarity of mind. You have killed both his future and present bodies and displayed your incredible prowess. Great Zhou will also be supporting your ascension. If you are willing to stop here, you will receive Great Zhou’s full support.”
Su Yu cursed inwardly.
He wanted to say that Great Zhou King was essentially acting like someone wanting to both be a maiden and a prostitute at the same time.

Clearly, Great Zhou King was insinuating that initially, he was not supportive of Su Yu. But for Great Yuan King’s sake, he had no choice but to change his stance on the proposal. Those from his faction shouldn’t blame him for this. He was doing this for humanity’s sake. He was doing this for Great Yuan King. He didn’t actually want this. He was very helpless as well. This was his message to his supporters.

And this would be his excuse for giving Su Yu his full support without taking any blame from his existing support base. He could even win Great Yuan King’s gratitude through this. Nobody knew that Great Zhou King, the crafty fox, was the actual culprit who had initiated the whole thing.
Su Yu sneered and said, “Great Zhou’s support? Leader of the holy land? Do I care about any of that?”

Then, he looked into the distance, toward those from Liu City. He asked, “Teachers, tell me. Should I kill my way out of the Human Realm today? Or should I spare this guy? If I were to kill my way out, would you be willing to come with me and leave humanity for good? I am confident I can kill my way out. With a death tunnel open, I can escape even with Great Qin King here!”
At that, numerous hearts thumped.
This included the myriad race visitors.
Was this…the start of a major battle?

Any carelessness might result in the death of everyone here. After all, Su Yu was considering even opening a death tunnel here. For some reason, the choice was left in the hands of those from Liu City.
Everyone moved their attentions away from Great Zhou King.
He no longer mattered here.
Liu Wenyan and the others were the ones making the choice here.
Numerous gazes focused on those from Liu City. What would they choose? Would they kill their way out with Su Yu? Or would they persuade Su Yu to spare Great Yuan King?
Thanks to this incident, everyone gained a much deeper understanding of Su Yu.
He was too arrogant.
He was also too domineering.
He was not the type to bow. He was not the type to compromise. Only his father and teachers could persuade him to change his mind.
What did this signify? The deaths of his father and teachers would fully release this beast upon the Myriad Realms.
An unbending beast.
The expressions of Liu Wenyan and the others changed repeatedly.
Zhao Li and Zhao Tianbing had lost all interest in Heavenly Forge King’s weaponsmithing.

With a frown, Zhao Li looked at Liu Wenyan, Bai Feng,, before looking at Su Yu. He solemnly said, “Su Yu, we dislike all these schemes within the Human Realm, but we are all humans. We were born here. We grew up here. Great Yuan King might not have deliberately gone against you. He was not of sound mind due to the issue with his tri-life bodies. Take my advice, Su Yu. Let this end here.”
Great Yuan King was the one who had suffered the loss of two bodies, yet it somehow sounded like Su Yu was the one who had been bullied here.

However, nobody protested. After all, Great Yuan King was indeed the one to attack first. Even those from Great Yuan couldn’t deny that. Nobody had expected Great Yuan King to suddenly lose control over himself.

And thus, it was up to Su Yu and those from Liu City whether Great Yuan King died or lived. Su Yu was only doing this because he felt like humanity was deliberately inviting him back to insult him. That was what most people believed.

Liu Wenyan sighed and said, “End it here, Su Yu. At worst, we will leave the Human Realm after this. There is no need to kill Great Yuan King here. Since the Human Realm does not want us here, we leave. With our departure, they will have no reason to keep targeting us.”
His sigh seemed to carry boundless helplessness and suffering.

Bai Feng gnashed his teeth and said, “We decided to return because we believed that with Su Yu’s growth, he could finally help humanity. Who cares about the bullshit holy land? Who cares about being the leader of the stupid holy land? We only returned because we wanted the help. But these bastards kept pushing us. Damn them all! We only wanted Su Yu to lead the holy land to help humanity more. What’s the big deal about all these human experts? Great Yuan King? What’s the big deal about him? He couldn’t even protect his tri-life bodies from my student!”
He was furious.
He scanned the crowd and said, “Shameless bastards. Screw the Human Realm. Screw the holy land. We don’t care anymore. We can live a much better life in the Allheaven Battlefield!”
Fury.
Sorrow.
Disappointment.
Those of the multiple character faction seemed boundlessly furious and disappointed.
